title: rosa lutetiana var. sphaerica
intro: Rosa lutetiana var. sphaerica, commonly known as the Dwarf Alpenrose or Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, contributing to its use in treating various conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in Rosa lutetiana var. sphaerica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
